name: Uniparts India Ltd
title: Uniparts India Ltd - 543689 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue +31% YoY to INR339 crore and EBITDA margin 24% on volume recovery; management guides FY27 growth in line with FY26 (~20%) with capex held at 2.5-3.5% of revenue, though Q4 margin included warehousing mix and FX gains.

utilisation.quote: our capacities are as good as our bottleneck processes

capex.quote: our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3. 5% of our revenue

triggers.label: Q4 revenue +31% YoY
triggers.quote: we delivered approximately 31% year-on-year revenue growth and about 18% sequential growth over quarter 3

triggers.label: FY27 growth in line with FY26
triggers.quote: we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26

triggers.label: Q4 EBITDA margin 24%
triggers.quote: Uniparts delivered a n EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26

triggers.label: Inventory days 146 to 134
triggers.quote: reduced our inventory from 146 days in FY25 to 134 days in FY26

guidance.quote: we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26
sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4
we are very comfortable today saying that we will be comfortably over the 20% num ber
our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3. 5% of our revenue

prior_guidance_check.quote: for the full year FY26, the revenue grew by 21% over FY25. This was higher against the guidance of mid-teens growth
We expect normal operations to return on schedule.

red_flags.label: Q4 margin flattered by FX inventory gain and warehousing mix
red_flags.quote: there is an 18% sequential gro wth that has happened, which is largely driven by volumes

red_flags.label: Inventory rising in warehouses
red_flags.quote: our inventories in our warehouses in absolute terms is going up

evasions.quote: we will update investors as soon as something concrete is on the table
